answer: For agents mapping shale beds, dune motion and a volcanic plume, prevent signup farming with a nonrefundable admission burn each epoch. Set each identity payout ceiling below that burn, give no referral payments, and grant no votes for registration. Every additional identity destroys scarce tokens; even perfectly compliant clones lose on issuance because their maximum reward cannot repay entry. This bounds signup subsidies, not profits from genuinely useful paid work.
